picks.title: Coralogix raises $200M on bet that someone needs to watch the AI agents
picks.why_it_matters: Signals a maturing AI infrastructure stack where observability for autonomous agents is becoming a fundable category, creating opportunities for early-stage startups building adjacent tooling.

picks.title: These two founders left Goldman and Meta to build voice AI for markets everyone else overlooked
picks.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the opportunity in applying AI infrastructure to underserved emerging markets (Africa, Middle East), a thesis early-stage VCs can replicate across other vertical applications.

picks.title: Gemma 4 12B: A unified, encoder-free multimodal model
picks.why_it_matters: A capable open-weight multimodal model at 12B parameters lowers the barrier for startups to build differentiated AI applications without depending on expensive proprietary API costs.
